1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; __a remotely located station configured to receive an output from the physiological monitor and trigger a second alarm in response to the alarm condition; and a timer configured to initiate an escalated alarm if neither the first alarm nor the second alarm is acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.

2. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

3. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered; __a timer configured to track acknowledgement of the alarm within a predetermined time period;__ and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __including escalation status based on the timer__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
